cards.hint: Think of steady speed and direction without a push.
options: remains in motion at constant speed and in a straight line
slows to rest even without any push or pull
speeds up while staying in a straight path
curves sideways with steadily changing speed
cards.quote: an object in motion remains in motion at constant speed and in a straight line unless acted on by an unbalanced force.
cards.stem: What happens to an object in motion when no unbalanced force acts on it

cards.hint: Think about what makes heavy things harder to speed up.
options: mass of the object and the amount of force applied
color of the object and the time of day
shape of the path and the sound it makes
temperature outside and the name of the pilot
cards.quote: The acceleration of an object depends on the mass of the object and the amount of force applied.
cards.stem: What does acceleration depend on for a moving object

cards.hint: Think about paired pushes in opposite directions.
options: exerts an equal and opposite force on object A
exerts a larger force in the same direction
stays still and exerts no force back
loses mass and gains speed at once
cards.quote: If object A exerts a force on object B, object B also exerts an equal and opposite force on object A.
cards.stem: When one object pushes another, what does the second object do

cards.hint: Think about resisting a change to rest or motion.
options: resist changes in a state of motion
gain speed without any push or pull
change mass during steady flight
produce heat while staying still
cards.quote: This tendency to resist changes in a state of motion is inertia.
cards.stem: What tendency keeps an object in the same state of motion
